t: 亨利三世成为了法国国王.
te: Henry III becomes King of France.
dz: 亨利三世成为了法国国王.
de: Henry III becomes King of France.

t: 古鲁·拉姆·达斯成为第四世锡克教古鲁/大师.
te: Guru Ram Das becomes the Fourth Sikh Guru/Master.
dz: 古鲁·拉姆·达斯成为第四世锡克教古鲁/大师.
de: Guru Ram Das becomes the Fourth Sikh Guru/Master.

t: 莱顿之围被"水上"号解除.
te: The Siege of Leiden is lifted by the Watergeuzen.
dz: 莱顿之围被"水上"号解除.
de: The Siege of Leiden is lifted by the Watergeuzen.

t: 西班牙航海家胡安·费尔南德斯发现现在被称为"胡安·费尔南德斯群岛"(Juan Fernánde…
te: Spanish navigator Juan Fernández discovers islands now known as the Juan Fernández Islands off Chile.
dz: 西班牙航海家胡安·费尔南德斯发现现在被称为"胡安·费尔南德斯群岛"(Juan Fernández Islands off Chile)的岛屿.
de: Spanish navigator Juan Fernández discovers islands now known as the Juan Fernández Islands off Chile.
